title: This London pub is home to ghosts, a highwayman and a phantom horse
excerpt: The Spaniards Inn in Hampstead has been named one of the UK's most haunted pubs, with legends of Dick Turpin, a lady in white and other ghostly sightings.
content:
A historic London pub has been named among the most haunted in the UK, with several ghosts reportedly lurking around the building, including a notorious highwayman.

The Spaniards Inn in Hampstead, located on Spaniards Road near Hampstead Heath, ranked fifth in a new list compiled by card machine provider Dojo.

The research drew on Reddit threads, online reviews, and accounts from pub landlords.

According to legend, the pub was once a hideout for the infamous highwayman Dick Turpin, who was executed in York in 1739.

Turpin is said to still haunt the inn.

Other supernatural sightings include the ghost of Juan, a man believed to have died in a duel nearby, and a mysterious lady in white seen wandering the beer garden.

A phantom horse is also associated with the pub.

The Golden Fleece in York took the top spot on Dojo’s haunted pubs list, with 15 reported ghosts.

Ye Olde Salutation Inn in Nottingham placed second with six ghosts.

The Black Swan Inn in York ranked third with five ghosts and a cat.

The Red Lion Inn in Avebury, Wiltshire, came fourth with five ghosts.

The Dojo spokesperson added: "We’d recommend visiting The Spaniards Inn in Hampstead, London, said to be haunted by the ghost of Dick Turpin and his horse, as well as a man named Juan who was killed in a duel and a lady in white who haunts the pub's garden."

All claims are based on folklore and reported sightings rather than verified paranormal evidence.

With Halloween approaching on October 31, The Spaniards Inn continues to draw visitors eager to experience its spooky history and traditional charm.
